# Archerlab Games
> Free browser-based web game portal — play instantly, no download needed.

## About
Archerlab Games is a web game portal where you can play various casual games directly in the browser. All games are free and require no installation.

## Games
- [Lumen Shift](https://game.archerlab.dev/lumen-shift/): Music-reactive falling-block puzzle
- [Jelly Pang 2048](https://game.archerlab.dev/jelly-pang-2048/): Jelly merge puzzle
- [Parking Escape](https://game.archerlab.dev/parking-escape/): Sliding-car parking puzzle
- [Jewelria](https://game.archerlab.dev/jewelria/): Match-3 jewel puzzle
- [School Zombie Defense](https://game.archerlab.dev/school-zombie-defense/): Vertical zombie defense game
- [BlockPang](https://game.archerlab.dev/blockpang/): Block placement puzzle
- [Shadow Survival](https://game.archerlab.dev/solo-leveling/): 2D dungeon survival game
- [Cat Tower](https://game.archerlab.dev/cat-tower/): Physics-based cat merge puzzle
- [Slime Volley](https://game.archerlab.dev/slimevolley/): Browser volleyball game

## Features
- 100% browser-based — no download or install
- Mobile and desktop support
- Free to play

## Links
- Play now: https://game.archerlab.dev
- Developer: https://archerlab.dev

## Language
- Korean (한국어), with English available on selected games
